$comment: Field inventory of Aqar's internal GraphQL schema captured via introspection on 2026-08-24. Internal and unsupported endpoint; fields may change without notice.

contactDetailsGating.summary: Aqar withholds contact details from unauthenticated requests. Schema exposes them, but live responses never populate them anonymously.
contactDetailsGating.observed: phone_1=null, phone_2=null, owner_name=null, user.phone=0, hide_contact_details=false, disable_phone=false on every tested listing

searchSort.summary: Web.find accepts a sort variable, but live responses have been observed ignoring price ordering.

cliFieldUsage.summary: The CLI requests the same 10 GraphQL fields in both operations; 8 are mapped into normalized output.

webListingVsInternalListing.summary: Web.listing returns WebListing (196 fields) and Web.find returns ElasticWebListing listings (180 fields). The internal Listing type (192 fields) is a different object used by root Query.Listing containers; its contact/owner fields are not necessarily available on the web-facing types.
